name: Priya Nair
preference: Prefers a config change, feature-flag toggle, or resource resize (e.g. connection pool size) over a full service rollback -- repeated rollbacks have failed to fix connection-pool-related incidents on payments-api.

name: Rahul Mehta
preference: Prefers scaling out consumer replicas over changing Kafka partition counts live -- live repartitioning has triggered rebalance storms before.

name: Ananya Iyer
preference: Prefers setting explicit TTLs and eviction policies over manually flushing caches.

name: David Kim
preference: Prefers rolling back a specific bad dependency or image version over a broad service rollback.

name: Sofia Martinez
preference: Prefers disabling the responsible feature flag before reaching for an infra-level fix.

name: Arjun Verma
preference: Prefers failing over to a backup provider over waiting out a rate limit or outage.

name: Emily Chen
preference: Prefers fixing the root cause (cert renewal, config) over restarting pods as a first response.
